rating.verdict: Built on Izzet Prowess, one of Modern's top decks in 2026 that keeps winning leagues and events. Two Harmonic Prodigy replace Stormchaser's Talent for theme, a small cost; it's still a competitive deck.
strengths: Very fast: wins on turn 4 or earlier
Cheap and free spells (Mutagenic Growth, Mishra's Bauble) make huge prowess turns
Harmonic Prodigy makes Slickshot Show-Off get +4/+0 per spell
weaknesses: Low life total from fetches, shocks and Phyrexian mana
Cheap blockers and lifegain slow it down
Graveyard hate weakens Dragon's Rage Channeler

wins: Play a cheap creature, then chain cheap spells: each one grows your attackers through prowess and Slickshot Show-Off, so a single combat can deal 10 or more.
plan: Monastery Swiftspear (haste) or Dragon's Rage Channeler; Mishra's Bauble and Preordain fill the graveyard.
Slickshot Show-Off (flying, haste) or Cori-Steel Cutter; attack and cast spells after blockers.
Two spells in a turn make a Monk token from Cori-Steel Cutter. Harmonic Prodigy doubles Slickshot's bonus.
Burn the last points with Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart.
keys: Flying haste; +2/+0 for each noncreature spell, doubled with Harmonic Prodigy.
Abilities of your other Wizards trigger twice: Slickshot Show-Off is a Wizard.
Your second spell each turn makes a 1/1 prowess Monk; equip it for +1/+1, trample and haste.
Surveils on every spell and becomes a 3/3 flyer with delirium.
Free +2/+2 (pay 2 life): a free prowess trigger and combat trick.
tips: Cast spells after blockers are declared so the opponent can't block around your pump.
Lava Dart's flashback sacrifices a Mountain (Steam Vents counts): two pings and two prowess triggers from one card.
Harmonic Prodigy doesn't double Swiftspear or DRC's prowess, only Wizards and Shamans.
Watch your life total against aggro: fetch, shock and Mutagenic Growth all cost life.
mulligan: Keep 1–3 lands with a one- or two-drop creature and a few spells. Hands with no creature are usually a mulligan.
sideboard: Consign to Memory, Surgical Extraction, Tormod's Crypt
Unholy Heat, Into the Flood Maw
